_comment: Placeholder brand tokens — swap these for your own site's design tokens. Colors are RGBA arrays. panel = the card background, border = its outline, accent/eyebrow = the highlight color. Fonts are tried in order, so list your brand font first and keep the system fallbacks. 'wordmark' is a PNG path relative to this file; add one (e.g. assets/wordmark.png) and every full-screen card gets it at the foot.
